habitat: Gypsum and highly gypseous soil mixed with surrounding substrate. Area geologically diverse. Gypsum endemic flora with Anulocaulis leiosolenus var. lasianthus, Sartwellia, and Tiquilia hispidissima most common. Conditions good.
locality: At W edge of Sierra Boquilla.
identificationRemarks: Det. given as: Nama cf. stewartii.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
name: Nama stewartii I.M.Johnst.

name: Nama stewartii I.M.Johnst.
